font.reason: A neutral Persian product UI sans suited to the compact navigation labels. Its connected forms and ZWNJ render cleanly; FaRoot loads the font before frames are rendered.

rtlDecisions.what: Marker and label within each navigation row
rtlDecisions.action: Inherited direction:rtl places the first flex child, the hue swatch, at the right; the Persian label follows to its left.
rtlDecisions.why: Marker placement follows the reading order of a Persian navigation item.

rtlDecisions.what: Order of the six navigation entries
rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original top-to-bottom order and all six stagger positions.
rtlDecisions.why: Vertical sequence is unaffected by writing direction; preserving it retains the intended menu order and cadence.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original scale and vertical translateY entrance, opacity curve, easing, and timing windows.
rtlDecisions.why: The motion is vertical and physical, with no reading-direction meaning.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original linear translateY(16 to -16) across the full duration.
rtlDecisions.why: Vertical drift is physical and the prompt defines it as an independent, continuous motion layer.

rtlDecisions.what: Centered stack, row geometry, and hue swatches
rtlDecisions.action: Kept the centered composition, hue sequence, gradient angle, and decorative shapes; adjusted vertical padding from 9px to 8px and line-height from 1 to 1.25.
rtlDecisions.why: Centering and hue decoration have no reading direction. Slightly reduced padding compensates for the Persian font size and taller line box, maintaining row proportions.

components.motionFidelity: Duration remains 108 frames at 30 fps. E.outBack, six seg windows (0.06 + i*0.09 through +0.24), scale range, opacity multiplier, 14-to-0px row offset, and linear 16-to--16px container drift are unchanged. Persian label lengths do not alter any beat, stagger count, or hold.
components.rasterHandling: No raster, video, or baked-in text assets are used. The colored swatches are CSS gradients without text.
components.persianCraft: All labels are rendered as whole joined strings; no character splitting, letter spacing, or uppercase transform. ZWNJ is present in پروژه‌ها. No digits, Latin mixed-direction runs, typing, or handwriting effects occur.
components.visualReview: Viewed Persian and original frame pairs at frames 0, 8, 16, 24, 36, 54, 72, 90, and 107. Frame 36 confirms the fourth row is entering while the first three are settled in both versions; later frames show all six rows and the continuing upward drift. Persian shaping and icon/label order are legible with no clipping.

sourceComparison.summary: The vertical list retains the gradual six-row assembly, soft scale settling, independent continuous container drift, and end hold.

verification.stillRenderResult: Succeeded; one composition rendered all requested Persian and original frames with no reported errors.
verification.finalVideoResult: Succeeded; harness rendered the 108-frame Persian MP4 for demo-ListReveal with no reported errors.
